decisions.summary: Add an organization stage receipt adapter so LFG and LFG-goal evidence can become schema-backed stage handoff receipts, with explicit local emission and explicit work-item updates.

verification_commands.expected: status pass with committed receipt validation, emitted_receipts 0, work_item_updates 0, and irreversible_actions 0
registry accepts the P28 work item and release receipt_ref
focused P28 receipt and integration tests pass

observed_results.summary: P28 adds a committed organization stage receipt contract, schema-backed receipt and report validation, explicit --emit and --apply-work-item-update paths, CI/package-index integration, and a release receipt linked from a completed P28 work item.

decisions.rollback_or_follow_up: Rollback by removing the CI step, stage receipt docs/schemas/gate, and P28 work-item/receipt if the adapter proves noisy; follow up with a policy promotion gate before adding runtime listeners or controlled execution.
